title: Desk Lamp with Charger, 10%-100% Stepless Dimmable & 5 Color Modes Study Lamp, Touch Control, 30-/60-minute Timer, USB Charging Output Port, CRI≥90, Eye-Caring Foldable LED Desk Lamps for Home Office
reviews: Great little lamp lots of great ample light output. Very useful and easy to adjust and move able. Very stylish looking piece of furniture. Great fit for a a small dark room.
Love this lamp!! I use it at work it has several different light colors and levels. It can move up and down as well as sideways!!! Perfect for the office.

I use a lamp to scrapbook, I needed one for travel as the others are too big, bulky, and not able to transport well. This light has different brightness levels, adjusts to fit my needs, is flexible and easy to pack and go!

It worked well. I plugged it in and I push the on off button and it went on. And I push that button again and it went off. It is a timer, but I don’t know how to work it. It has some other buttons and colors and stuff that I can’t figure out but I didn’t want any of that. I just wanted a light and this is good, small and Bright.
The switch’s do not work well at all
Light weight desk lamp with different light settings. I like that the light is long and i can adjust it. Highly recommend

This desk lamp lights up my desk very well. The LED brightness can be easily adjusted. The USB charging port on the back of the base is usefull. The arm that holds the lighting element is a fixed height (10 inches from the base to the hinged arm). The on/off touch switch is difficult to find in the dark because it does not stick up from the surface of the base.
